findings.title: shrink: the envelope-to-status mapping is a copy of respond()
findings.detail: Same line as respond() at src/libs/api/route-handler.ts:19-21; the copies can drift. Export respond and reuse it.

findings.title: Architectural drift / authn: sweep forwarded upstream with no credential
findings.detail: `apiServer` gets its upstream bearer only from the user session (src/libs/api/server.ts:11, src/libs/api/base-fetcher.ts:35-37). The scheduler sends no next-auth cookie, so POST /v1/reminders/sweep goes upstream with no Authorization header: either upstream rejects it (reminders never send) or upstream accepts sweeps from anyone. Fix forward by sending a service credential via apiServer.post's options.headers, or confirm and document how upstream authenticates this endpoint.
